intro: We list {{count}} government MBA / PGDM programme options across {{colleges}} public institutes in Uttar Pradesh. The list is meant to help you compare the best government MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh by recorded average package.
IIM Lucknow, IIT Kanpur and Banaras Hindu University sit near the top. They lead the top MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh 2026, and the remaining public institutes follow by package.
listLead: IIM Lucknow and Banaras Hindu University appear more than once because we hold several programmes. The Noida campus of IIM Lucknow is listed separately from the Lucknow campus.
snapshot: Among these {{colleges}} public colleges, the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, from placement years {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
Recorded averages run from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The highest single figure we hold is {{highestMax}}, which is not a typical offer.
CAT is the main entrance route on this list. A few programmes also mention CUET PG or GMAT, so check the official notice for the campus you want.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Lucknow is 5th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Its 2025–27 PGP fee notice lists ₹10.95 lakh in year one and ₹9.80 lakh in year two, or ₹20.75 lakh in all.
Our card now shows that official two-year total of ₹20.75 lakh. IIT Kanpur also appears twice: as the institute and as Industrial and Management Engineering.

sections.heading: NIRF 2025 ranks for government MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh
paragraphs: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Lucknow is 5th, IIT Kanpur is 27th, Banaras Hindu University is 60th, and Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology is 83rd.
The Noida campus of IIM Lucknow is not ranked separately. Use the parent institute's rank, and confirm placements for the programme taught on that campus.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh
paragraphs: A two-year PGP at IIM Lucknow, an MBA at a university faculty, and a specialised course in footwear or petroleum are not interchangeable.
Before you shortlist, check the official documents for:
bullets: The full two-year fee, not a single-year total that can look lower than it is.
The placement year and the exact programme behind the average and highest figures.
Whether the campus is Lucknow, Noida, Varanasi, Kanpur or another city, because the peer group differs.
The entrance test and category cut-off for the latest cycle.

faqs.question: How many government MBA colleges in Uttar Pradesh are listed here?
faqs.answer: We hold {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} public institutes. IIM Lucknow, Banaras Hindu University and a few others appear more than once because we hold several programmes.

faqs.question: What is IIM Lucknow's official MBA fee for 2025–27?
faqs.answer: The institute's PGP fee notice for 2025–27 lists ₹10.95 lakh in the first year and ₹9.80 lakh in the second year, or ₹20.75 lakh in all, plus mess charges. Our card now shows that official two-year total of ₹20.75 lakh.

faqs.question: What average package do these government colleges report?
faqs.answer: The median recorded average is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. Some rows, such as MNNIT Allahabad in 2015, are old, so check the latest official report.

faqs.question: Is the Noida campus of IIM Lucknow ranked on its own?
faqs.answer: No. In the NIRF 2025 Management ranking the parent institute, IIM Lucknow, is 5th. The Noida campus is not given a separate rank.

faqs.question: Why does IIT Kanpur appear twice?
faqs.answer: One row is listed under the institute, with a 2017 placement year. The other is Industrial and Management Engineering, with a 2023 MBA average of ₹18 LPA in our records. Both refer to IIT Kanpur.
